expected_freight: Out-of-time model-derived quantity; downstream analyses inherit upstream uncertainty.
distance: Great-circle/Haversine geographic proxy; not road-network distance.
volume: Product-volume-sum proxy; not observed parcel cubage.
GDP: Retrospective contextual variable; not point-in-time operational information.
population: Annual municipal estimate with publication-timing caveat.
ANP: Municipal missingness is preserved; state-level context remains separate.
causality: Observational associations only; no causal identification.
GNADMM: No claim of global convergence for the complete external nonlinear sequence.
curvature_constraint: beta_z2 >= 0 is an imposed modeling hypothesis and is not evidence of a true U-shaped mechanism.
